maple-tf-001.en: Imagine meeting a friend: you wave and say this word first.
maple-tf-001.zh: 想象刚遇见朋友：你挥挥手，先说这个词。

maple-tf-002.en: Think about what you say after someone helps you.
maple-tf-002.zh: 想想别人帮助你之后，你会对他说什么。

maple-tf-003.en: Picture the people in the house next door.
maple-tf-003.zh: 想想住在你家隔壁房子里的人。

maple-tf-004.en: Picture a cup with nothing inside. How would you describe it?
maple-tf-004.zh: 想象杯子里面什么都没有，你会怎样形容它？

maple-tf-005.en: At a bakery, bread can be sold as one whole piece or as slices.
maple-tf-005.zh: 面包店里的面包可以整条出售，也可以切成片。

maple-tf-006.en: Notice the word night. Think about the time of day.
maple-tf-006.zh: 注意 night 这个词，想想这句话适合一天中的什么时候。

maple-tf-007.en: Picture turning the handle so a person can walk through.
maple-tf-007.zh: 想象转动门把手，让一个人能够走进来。

maple-tf-008.en: Imagine a person helping an elderly neighbor carry a bag.
maple-tf-008.zh: 想象有人主动帮年老的邻居提袋子。

maple-tf-009.en: Think about how you feel when you have not eaten lunch.
maple-tf-009.zh: 想想还没吃午饭时，身体会有什么感觉。

maple-tf-010.en: Compare: I am, you are, he/she/it ___.
maple-tf-010.zh: 比较：I am、you are、he/she/it 后面该用哪个 be 动词？

forest-tf-001.en: Hikers follow a marked route between the trees.
forest-tf-001.zh: 徒步旅行的人沿着树林中标记好的路线前进。

forest-tf-002.en: Imagine a library where everyone reads without speaking.
forest-tf-002.zh: 想象图书馆里大家都在读书，没有人说话。

forest-tf-003.en: Picture the small green shapes growing on a tree's branches.
forest-tf-003.zh: 想象树枝上长着的、一片片绿色的部分。

forest-tf-004.en: Think about your clothes just after heavy rain.
forest-tf-004.zh: 想想刚淋过大雨后的衣服是什么状态。

forest-tf-005.en: Point with your left hand and compare it with the instruction.
forest-tf-005.zh: 用你的左手指一指，再和指示比较。

forest-tf-006.en: Look at a bird flying over the roof. Compare its position with the roof.
forest-tf-006.zh: 看一只飞过屋顶的鸟，比较鸟和屋顶的位置。

forest-tf-007.en: Imagine crossing a slippery bridge and watching every step.
forest-tf-007.zh: 想象经过一座很滑的桥，每一步都仔细观察。

forest-tf-008.en: If you follow a guide, do you move toward the guide or away?
forest-tf-008.zh: 如果你跟随向导，是朝向导走，还是远离他？

forest-tf-009.en: A tree has a trunk, roots and smaller woody arms.
forest-tf-009.zh: 一棵树有树干、树根，以及伸向四周的较细木质部分。

forest-tf-010.en: Picture a creature with feathers, wings and a hooked beak.
forest-tf-010.zh: 想象一种长着羽毛、翅膀和弯曲鸟喙的生物。

camp-tf-001.en: Think of taking a library book home and bringing it back later.
camp-tf-001.zh: 想想把图书馆的书带回家，过一段时间再归还。

camp-tf-002.en: Hold out both hands. Compare the two sides of your body.
camp-tf-002.zh: 伸出双手，比较身体的左右两侧。

camp-tf-003.en: Imagine a storm. Where would you go to stay safe and dry?
camp-tf-003.zh: 想象暴风雨来了，你会到什么地方躲避、保持安全和干燥？

camp-tf-004.en: When you follow a leader, you stay on the route the leader takes.
camp-tf-004.zh: 跟随带路的人时，你会沿着他走的路线前进。

camp-tf-005.en: Should often introduces something it would be good to do.
camp-tf-005.zh: Should 常用来表达做某件事会比较好。

camp-tf-006.en: Face the tent's entrance. Now imagine standing on its other side.
camp-tf-006.zh: 面向帐篷的入口，再想象站到帐篷的另一侧。

camp-tf-007.en: With he/she/it in the simple present, check the ending of the action verb.
camp-tf-007.zh: 一般现在时中，主语是 he/she/it 时，要检查动词的词尾。

camp-tf-008.en: Before camping, you pack useful things such as food, water and tools.
camp-tf-008.zh: 露营前，你会准备食物、水和工具等需要的东西。

camp-tf-009.en: Compare the structure: can + go, should + help, must + ___.
camp-tf-009.zh: 比较结构：can + go、should + help、must 后面的动词该用什么形式？

camp-tf-010.en: Picture walking from one riverbank to the other using a bridge.
camp-tf-010.zh: 想象通过一座桥，从河的一岸走到另一岸。
